events.name: Bash
events.head: Read T-058 accounts read-back and key var names

events.text: Quick fresh GET-only read to confirm the account is unchanged.

events.name: Bash
events.head: GET Tantra channel accounts (read-only)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; set -a; . ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env; set +a; curl -s -m 20 -H "x-[redacted]" "https://usetantra.com/api/v1/channels/accounts" | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);d=d.get('items',d) if isinstance(d,dict) else d;[print(a.get('id'),a.get('channel'),a.get('displayName'),a.get('identifier'),a.get('status')) for a in d]" 2>&1 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Tantra API base URL used in code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rhoE "https://[a-z.]*usetantra\.com/[a-z/]*api/v1" workshop-plan/scripts/first_lines.py cloud/src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -3
